title: Regulations to Ensure Safe Medical Practices and Science-based Treatments at Longevity-medicine Clinics
what_it_is: Regulations to Ensure Safe Medical Practices and Science-based Treatments at Longevity-medicine Clinics

sections.label: Medical treatment standards and enforcement
sections.summary: Medical practitioners must follow SMC ethical guidelines, provide evidence-based treatments, and face regulatory action or complaints for non-compliance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: In addition, medical practitioners are required to adhere to the Singapore Medical Council (SMC) Ethical Code and Ethical Guidelines (ECEG).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Both HCSA and SMC ECEG require medical service providers and practitioners to provide only safe, rational and evidence-based medical treatments in accordance with accepted clinical practice.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Where non-standard medical treatments are considered, they should only be provided in the context of a clinical study.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Such studies must comply with the ethical requirements for research studies including prior approval from a local Institutional Research Board.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These services are monitored through routine inspections and compliance audits, which may also be triggered by complaints.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Providers that fail to meet standards may be subject to regulatory action or enforcement measures including imprisonment and financial penalties.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: If the Ministry receives information that a medical practitioner has engaged in practices which are not in accordance with the SMC ECEG, the Ministry will lodge a complaint against the medical practitioner to the SMC.
